news.titleEn: Trump Says US to 'Substantially Reduce' Military Drills With South Korea
news.conclusionEn: President Trump ordered the Pentagon to scale back the annual Ulchi Freedom Shield joint military exercises with South Korea just as the 11-day drills were set to begin, citing his rapport with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普下令五角大楼在为期11天的「乙支自由护盾」联合军演开始前大幅削减规模，称与朝鲜金正恩关系良好。
news.whyEn: The move marks a significant shift in longstanding US-South Korea defense cooperation, comes days after North Korea's 11th ballistic missile test of the year, and could unsettle allies in the region who rely on the drills as a deterrence signal.
news.whyZh: 此举标志着美韩防务合作的重大转向，且发生在朝鲜今年第11次弹道导弹试射后几天，可能动摇依赖联合军演作为威慑信号的地区盟友。
news.detailEn: Trump announced on social media Sunday that he had instructed Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to "substantially reduce" the Joint Military Exercises with South Korea, calling them costly and "totally inappropriate and hostile" toward North Korea, which he described as "unthreatening and respectful" during his time in office. The Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises, involving about 18,000 South Korean troops, were scheduled to run for 11 days starting August 17. South Korea's Ministry of Defence said the drills would proceed as planned for now, highlighting a gap between Washington's stated intentions and Seoul's official position. The announcement came just five days after North Korea test-fired a midrange ballistic missile more than 700 kilometers into waters east of the peninsula, its 11th such test in 2026.
news.detailZh: 特朗普周日在社交媒体上宣布，已指示国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯「大幅削减」与韩国的联合军演，称演习成本高昂，且对朝鲜「极不恰当且带有敌意」，并称朝鲜在他任内「并无威胁、态度尊重」。涉及约1.8万名韩军的「乙支自由护盾」军演原定于8月17日起举行11天。韩国国防部表示演习目前仍按计划进行，凸显华盛顿表态与首尔官方立场之间的落差。这一宣布距朝鲜试射一枚飞行超700公里、落入半岛以东海域的中程弹道导弹仅五天，这是朝鲜今年第11次此类试射。

news.titleEn: Israel Strikes Lebanon as End of US-Iran Ceasefire Looms
news.conclusionEn: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon killed 11 people, including a senior Hezbollah commander, marking the deadliest day since a June ceasefire, as the US prepares a fresh sanctions package on Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列对黎巴嫩南部的空袭造成11人死亡，包括一名真主党高级指挥官，为6月停火以来最致命一天，美国同时正筹备新一轮对伊朗制裁。
news.whyEn: The escalation raises the risk of a wider breakdown between Israel and Hezbollah just as tensions between the US, Israel and Iran already sit near a boiling point, with implications for oil markets and Middle East stability.
news.whyZh: 局势升级增加以色列与真主党全面冲突的风险，叠加美伊以三方紧张关系接近临界点，将波及油价与中东局势稳定。
news.detailEn: The Israeli military said it killed Abu Hassan Alaa, a senior commander in Hezbollah's "Bader Unit," in a strike on what it described as a main Hezbollah headquarters in the Ansar municipality of southern Lebanon. Israel said the strike was in response to Hezbollah activity in a border "security zone," a day after it said three Israeli soldiers were seriously wounded in an attack it blamed on Hezbollah. The 11 deaths from Sunday's strikes make it the deadliest day since Israel and Hezbollah agreed to a ceasefire in early June. Separately, Bloomberg reported the US is preparing a fresh package of sanctions on Iran as the informal ceasefire in the broader US-Israel war on Iran, which began in February, appears increasingly fragile, with talks over reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping still deadlocked.
news.detailZh: 以色列军方表示，其在黎巴嫩南部安萨尔市镇一处所称的真主党主要总部实施空袭，击毙真主党「巴德尔部队」高级指挥官阿布·哈桑·阿拉。以方称此次打击是对真主党在边境「安全区」活动的回应，此前一天以方称三名以军士兵在一次被其归咎于真主党的袭击中重伤。周日空袭造成的11人死亡，是以色列与真主党6月初达成停火以来最致命的一天。另据彭博社报道，美国正筹备新一轮对伊朗制裁，此时始于2月的美伊以战争非正式停火状态愈发脆弱，围绕重开霍尔木兹海峡航运的谈判仍陷僵局。

news.titleEn: Anthropic Revenue Ahead of IPO Surges Over 14-Fold in Second Quarter
news.conclusionEn: AI startup Anthropic's preliminary second-quarter revenue surged more than 14-fold from a year earlier to over $11.5 billion, with the company also posting positive adjusted operating income as it prepares for a possible IPO.
news.conclusionZh: AI初创公司Anthropic第二季度初步营收同比暴增逾14倍，超过115亿美元，并首次实现调整后营业利润为正，为可能的IPO铺路。
news.whyEn: The scale of growth signals enterprise AI spending is accelerating faster than expected, intensifies competition with OpenAI for corporate customers, and could make Anthropic one of the first major private AI labs to go public as soon as this fall.
news.whyZh: 增长规模显示企业AI支出加速超出预期，也加剧Anthropic与OpenAI在企业客户上的竞争，公司最快今秋上市，有望成为首批上市的大型AI初创企业之一。
news.detailEn: Anthropic's preliminary revenue for the quarter climbed to more than $11.5 billion, up from $787 million a year earlier and from $4.73 billion in the first quarter of 2026, according to figures reported by Bloomberg. The company also reported positive adjusted operating income for the period, a milestone for an AI lab that, like rivals, has spent heavily on computing infrastructure and talent. The figures are preliminary and could still change once finalized. The revenue jump comes as Anthropic competes head-to-head with OpenAI for corporate customers, with its Claude models gaining particular traction among software developers and other professionals for coding and workplace tasks. People familiar with the matter have said Anthropic is preparing for a potential initial public offering as soon as this fall, which would make it one of the first major AI labs to list on public markets.
news.detailZh: 据彭博社报道的数据，Anthropic当季初步营收攀升至超过115亿美元，较去年同期的7.87亿美元和2026年第一季度的47.3亿美元大幅增长。公司同期还首次实现调整后营业利润为正，这对一家像同行一样在计算基础设施和人才上投入巨资的AI实验室而言是一个里程碑。上述数据为初步统计，最终确认后可能有所调整。营收激增之际，Anthropic正与OpenAI在企业客户争夺上正面交锋，其Claude模型尤其在软件开发者及其他职场用户的编程与办公任务中获得青睐。知情人士称，Anthropic正为最快今年秋季的潜在首次公开募股（IPO）做准备，若成行，将使其成为首批登陆公开市场的大型AI实验室之一。

news.titleEn: Berkshire Adds $17 Billion to Alphabet Stake
news.conclusionEn: Berkshire Hathaway's Q2 13F filing showed it added more than $17 billion to its Alphabet holding, pushing Google's parent past Bank of America to become the conglomerate's fourth-largest equity position.
news.conclusionZh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦第二季度13F持仓报告显示，其对Alphabet的持股增加逾170亿美元，谷歌母公司超越美国银行成为该公司第四大重仓股。
news.whyEn: The purchase helped make Berkshire a net buyer of stocks for the first time in fourteen quarters, a closely watched signal since Warren Buffett's team has spent years sitting on record cash reserves amid concerns markets were overvalued.
news.whyZh: 此次加仓令伯克希尔十四个季度以来首次成为股票净买家，这一信号备受市场关注，此前巴菲特团队因担忧市场估值过高已连续多年持有创纪录现金储备。
news.detailEn: Berkshire Hathaway's quarterly 13F filing, released August 15, showed the company added roughly 48.1 million shares of Alphabet's Class A and Class C stock during the second quarter, worth more than $17 billion, bringing its total stake to nearly 106 million shares worth about $36.6 billion. About 60% of the new shares came from a $10 billion private placement Berkshire and Alphabet announced in early June, with the rest purchased on the open market. Alphabet is now Berkshire's third-largest holding in its public equity portfolio. The filing also showed Berkshire increased its stakes in Delta Air Lines and homebuilders while exiting Constellation Brands, and marked the first quarter in fourteen that Berkshire was a net buyer rather than seller of stocks.
news.detailZh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦8月15日发布的季度13F持仓报告显示，公司二季度增持约4810万股Alphabet A类及C类股票，价值超过170亿美元，令其总持股增至近1.06亿股，价值约366亿美元。新增股份中约60%来自伯克希尔与Alphabet今年6月初宣布的一笔100亿美元私募配售，其余则通过公开市场购入。Alphabet目前已是伯克希尔公开股票投资组合中第三大重仓股。报告还显示，伯克希尔增持了达美航空及房屋建筑商股票，同时清仓星座品牌（Constellation Brands），这也是伯克希尔十四个季度以来首次成为股票净买家而非净卖家。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 Sets New Record, Clearing 7,800 for the First Time
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 closed at an all-time high of 7,798.99 on August 13, clearing 7,800 for the first time, powered by cooler-than-expected inflation data and a rally in AI-linked semiconductor stocks.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500指数8月13日收于7798.99点的历史新高，首次突破7800点，得益于低于预期的通胀数据及AI相关芯片股大涨。
news.whyEn: The milestone reflects growing investor confidence that the Federal Reserve will hold off on raising rates in September, even as separate data days later showed consumer sentiment souring, highlighting a widening gap between market optimism and household anxiety.
news.whyZh: 该里程碑反映投资者对美联储9月不加息的信心上升，但随后数据显示消费者信心恶化，凸显市场乐观情绪与民众忧虑之间的落差正在扩大。
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 climbed past 7,800 intraday and closed at a record 7,798.99 on Thursday, August 13, after both the Consumer Price Index and Producer Price Index came in below economists' forecasts, easing worries the Federal Reserve would need to raise rates at its September meeting. The Dow Jones Industrial Average also edged up to a record close near 53,840. Technology and semiconductor stocks led gains, with chipmakers benefiting from continued enthusiasm around AI infrastructure spending. The rally capped a third consecutive week of gains for the index, even as the market showed signs of fragility the following day, when the S&P slipped slightly and a separate report showed US consumer sentiment falling sharply in August.
news.detailZh: 标普500指数周四（8月13日）盘中突破7800点，收于7798.99点的历史新高，此前公布的消费者价格指数（CPI）和生产者价格指数（PPI）均低于经济学家预期，缓解了市场对美联储9月会议需要加息的担忧。道琼斯工业平均指数当日也创下约53840点的收盘新高。科技股与半导体股领涨，芯片制造商受益于市场对AI基础设施支出的持续热情。此次上涨也是该指数连续第三周上涨，不过次日市场已现脆弱迹象，标普小幅回落，另一份报告显示美国8月消费者信心大幅下滑。

news.titleEn: Uber Partners With China's Pony.ai for 2,000 Robotaxis in Europe
news.conclusionEn: Uber and Chinese autonomous driving company Pony.ai expanded their partnership to deploy more than 2,000 robotaxis across Europe, building on their existing commercial service in Zagreb, Croatia.
news.conclusionZh: Uber与中国自动驾驶公司小马智行（Pony.ai）扩大合作，计划在欧洲部署逾2000辆自动驾驶出租车，在双方已在克罗地亚萨格勒布推出的商业化服务基础上扩展。
news.whyEn: The expansion signals Chinese autonomous-vehicle technology is gaining a foothold in Western markets through Uber's platform, potentially reshaping competition with US-based robotaxi operators like Waymo as the companies also eye deployment in the Middle East.
news.whyZh: 此次扩张显示中国自动驾驶技术正借助Uber平台进入西方市场，可能改变与Waymo等美国自动驾驶出租车运营商的竞争格局，双方还计划在中东部署车队。
news.detailEn: Pony.ai and Uber announced an expanded partnership on August 14 to deploy over 2,000 robotaxis across additional European cities, building on a partnership dating back to May 2025 when the companies first agreed to bring Pony.ai vehicles onto the Uber app internationally. Earlier this year the companies worked with Croatian mobility firm Verne to launch Europe's first commercial robotaxi service in Zagreb, with Verne acting as local fleet owner and operator. The expanded deal will add robotaxis to four more European cities, though the companies have not yet named them or given a launch timeline, saying details would be revealed in phases. The partnership also includes plans to deploy robotaxis in the Middle East.
news.detailZh: 小马智行与Uber于8月14日宣布扩大合作，计划在欧洲更多城市部署超过2000辆自动驾驶出租车，此次合作可追溯至2025年5月，双方彼时首次同意将小马智行车辆接入Uber国际版应用。今年早些时候，两家公司曾与克罗地亚出行公司Verne合作，在萨格勒布推出欧洲首个商业化自动驾驶出租车服务，由Verne担任当地车队所有者及运营方。此次扩大的合作将在另外四个欧洲城市增设自动驾驶出租车服务，但双方尚未公布具体城市名称或上线时间表，称细节将分阶段公布。合作还包括在中东部署自动驾驶出租车的计划。

news.titleEn: Trump Family-Backed Crypto Firm World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter Approval
news.conclusionEn: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted World Liberty Financial, the Trump family's crypto venture, conditional preliminary approval for a national trust bank charter, advancing its plans to issue stablecoins directly.
news.conclusionZh: 美国货币监理署（OCC）向特朗普家族旗下加密企业World Liberty Financial授予国家信托银行牌照的有条件初步批准，助其推进直接发行稳定币的计划。
news.whyEn: The approval is controversial given the sitting president's ownership stake in the company, prompting Democratic senators to draft legislation blocking government officials from owning banks, and it sets a precedent for how crypto firms can gain access to the regulated banking system.
news.whyZh: 由于现任总统本人持有该公司股份，此次批准引发争议，促使多名民主党参议员起草立法禁止政府官员持有银行，也为加密企业进入受监管银行体系树立了先例。
news.detailEn: The OCC said on August 14 that World Liberty Trust Co.'s application meets certain regulatory and policy requirements, granting preliminary conditional approval for a national trust bank charter. The charter would permit asset management and payment settlement activities and allow the company to issue stablecoins directly, but does not authorize deposit-taking or lending typical of traditional banks. The approval is conditional, not final — World Liberty must still raise capital and complete additional regulatory steps before the charter takes effect. The decision drew criticism from Democratic lawmakers over Trump's ownership stake in the broader World Liberty Financial entity; Senators Elizabeth Warren, Angela Alsobrooks and Ruben Gallego said they would introduce the "Ending Presidential Corruption in Banking Act" to bar senior government officials from owning or controlling a bank.
news.detailZh: OCC于8月14日表示，World Liberty Trust Co.的申请符合部分监管与政策要求，授予其国家信托银行牌照的初步有条件批准。该牌照将允许其从事资产管理及支付结算业务，并可直接发行稳定币，但不允许开展传统银行的吸收存款或放贷业务。此次批准为有条件性质而非最终批准——World Liberty仍需完成融资及其他监管程序，牌照方可正式生效。由于特朗普在更广泛的World Liberty Financial实体中持有股份，该决定招致民主党议员批评；参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦、安吉拉·阿尔索布鲁克斯及鲁本·加列戈表示，将提出《终结总统银行业腐败法案》，禁止政府高级官员持有或控制银行。

news.titleEn: US Consumer Sentiment Falls in August 2026, Ending Recovery
news.conclusionEn: The University of Michigan's preliminary Index of Consumer Sentiment dropped to 51.0 in August from 55.2 in July, a 7.6% decline that reversed two months of improvement as inflation worries linked to the Middle East conflict weighed on households.
news.conclusionZh: 密歇根大学消费者信心指数8月初值降至51.0，较7月的55.2下滑7.6%，中断此前两个月的回升，中东冲突引发的通胀担忧拖累民众信心。
news.whyEn: The steep drop, well below the 54.5 consensus estimate, suggests American households are growing more pessimistic about inflation and job prospects even as stock markets hit record highs, a divergence that could weigh on consumer spending heading into the fall.
news.whyZh: 此次大幅下滑远低于54.5的市场预期，显示尽管股市屡创新高，美国家庭对通胀和就业前景却日趋悲观，这种分化可能拖累今秋消费支出。
news.detailEn: The preliminary August reading fell short of the 54.5 consensus forecast and sits well below August 2025's level of 58.2. The Index of Consumer Expectations dropped 8.7% to 50.6, while the Current Economic Conditions gauge slid 5.5% to 51.8. Year-ahead inflation expectations rose to 4.3% from 4.2% in July, exceeding the 3.4% reading recorded in February just before the US-Israel war on Iran began. Sentiment fell across demographic and political lines, with Republicans posting the steepest drop — now 19% below pre-conflict readings and the lowest since the 2024 election — while lower-income households, older consumers and those without college degrees were also hit hard. Only 8% of consumers now expect their income growth to outpace inflation over the coming year.
news.detailZh: 8月初值低于54.5的市场预期，也远低于2025年8月58.2的水平。消费者预期指数下滑8.7%至50.6，当前经济状况指数下滑5.5%至51.8。未来一年通胀预期从7月的4.2%升至4.3%，超过2月美伊以战争爆发前3.4%的水平。信心下滑覆盖各人口及政治群体，其中共和党支持者跌幅最大——较冲突前水平低19%，为2024年大选以来最低——低收入家庭、老年消费者及无大学学历人群同样受到重创。目前仅8%的消费者预计未来一年收入增速能跑赢通胀。

businessTips.explanationEn: Economies of scale describe how a company's average cost per unit falls as its total production volume rises, because fixed costs like factories, software licenses, or R&D get spread across more units sold. This is a core reason larger competitors can often underprice smaller rivals while still protecting margins, and why many industries naturally consolidate over time. It only holds up to a point — beyond a certain size, coordination costs and complexity can cause diseconomies of scale to set in instead.
businessTips.explanationZh: 规模经济是指企业总产量增加时，单位产品的平均成本随之下降，因为工厂、软件许可、研发等固定成本可以分摊到更多产品上。这也是大公司常能在压低售价的同时仍保持利润的核心原因，也解释了为何许多行业会随时间自然走向整合。但规模经济效应并非无限——超过一定规模后，协调成本与组织复杂度上升，反而可能出现「规模不经济」。
businessTips.exampleEn: A large cloud computing provider spends billions building data centers, but because millions of customers share that infrastructure, its cost per gigabyte of storage keeps dropping — letting it undercut a small startup that has to build or rent similar infrastructure for a fraction of the customer base.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家大型云计算服务商投入数十亿美元建设数据中心，但由于数百万客户共享这些基础设施，其每GB存储的成本不断下降——这使其能够以更低价格击败一家客户基数小得多、却要为类似基础设施建设或租用买单的小型创业公司。

businessTips.explanationEn: CAC is the total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers gained in a given period, and it's one of the first numbers any founder should track. A side hustle or startup can look like it's growing fast, but if CAC is higher than what each customer pays over their lifetime (LTV), the business is losing money on every new signup no matter how good the top-line growth looks. Founders often only discover this problem after scaling ad spend, which is why tracking CAC from day one matters.
businessTips.explanationZh: 获客成本（CAC）是指某段时期内的销售与营销总支出除以新增客户数，是创业者最早就该追踪的关键指标之一。副业或初创企业看起来增长迅猛，但如果获客成本高于每位客户带来的终身价值（LTV），那么无论表面增速多好看，每新增一个客户其实都在亏钱。许多创业者往往是在扩大广告投放后才发现这个问题，这正是为什么从第一天起就该追踪CAC。
businessTips.exampleEn: A side-hustle founder selling a $30 online course spends $40 in Instagram ads to land each new customer. Even if hundreds of people sign up, the business loses $10 per customer before accounting for any other costs — a warning sign that shows up clearly once CAC is tracked against price, but can easily hide behind a rising follower count.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位副业创业者销售一门售价30美元的在线课程，平均每获得一位新客户就要花费40美元的Instagram广告费。即便有数百人报名，在计入其他成本之前，公司实际上每单就亏损10美元——这一警讯只有在将CAC与售价对比时才会清晰显现，而单看粉丝数增长很容易将其掩盖。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging means investing a fixed amount of money at regular intervals — say, monthly — regardless of whether the market is up or down, rather than trying to time a single lump-sum purchase. Because the fixed amount buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, it naturally lowers your average cost per share over time and removes the emotional guesswork of trying to pick the perfect entry point. It doesn't guarantee better returns than investing a lump sum all at once, but it reduces the risk of investing everything right before a downturn.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（美元成本平均法）是指无论市场涨跌，都按固定金额定期（例如每月）投资，而不是试图一次性择时买入。由于固定金额在价格低时能买到更多份额、价格高时买到较少份额，长期下来会自然拉低平均每股成本，也省去了猜测最佳入场时机的心理负担。定投并不保证收益一定优于一次性投入，但能降低「刚好在下跌前全仓买入」的风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor puts $500 into an index fund on the first of every month rather than investing $6,000 all at once in January. When the market dips in March, that month's $500 buys more shares at a lower price, smoothing out the investor's average purchase cost over the year compared with a single lump-sum bet on January's price.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者选择每月1日定投500美元到指数基金，而不是在1月一次性投入6000美元。当市场在3月下跌时，当月的500美元能以更低价格买到更多份额，相比一月一次性押注单一价格，全年下来的平均购买成本被有效拉平。
